translation_notes: Warning 1 (measurement artefact): all five Literal(v) calls (gap, slope, prior_gap, 3, 95.0) carry no explicit datatype=; kept via default coercion as bare {expr} interpolation, no ^^ added -- this region is part of the untyped subset the stratum's overly broad sampling criterion also captures.

PSDO is an AliasingDefinedNamespace: PSDO.performance_gap_content etc. resolve through an internal _alias dict to numeric codes (e.g. PSDO_0000106), not to a literal '.../performance_gap_content' suffix. A prefixed name psdo:performance_gap_content would therefore build a WRONG IRI, so PSDO/SLOWMO member access is kept as runtime interpolation {PSDO.x} (pass-through of an already-built URIRef), not declared as a lexical @prefix. RDF.type/RDF.value have no such aliasing and are safely rewritten as the prefixed name rdf:type/rdf:value.

r.add(...)/c.set(...) on the rdflib Resource wrapper (graph.resource(BNode())) translated to +{ } against @graph graph, using {r.identifier}/{c.identifier} as subject: Resource.add/set write to the same underlying graph via self._identifier, and .set() behaves exactly like .add() here since there is no prior value for that (s,p). r/c are kept as real Resource objects (not reduced to bare BNodes) because Loss.moderators([r]) needs the Resource API afterwards.

Consecutive r.add(...) calls on the same subject merged into single +{ s p1 o1 ; p2 o2 ; ... } runs (add_run_shared_subject idiom); the c block and the trailing r.add(SLOWMO.RegardingComparator, c) are kept as separate islands since they are not contiguous with the first run.

External dependency blocks the pilot, not the translation: even original.py alone fails at import time (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src' outside the real repo checkout; inside it, 'from src.bitstomach.signals import Loss' pulls in signals/__init__.py's unconditional 'from src import startup', which needs pandas, python-dotenv, loguru and requests_file -- none installed in the study venv -- plus a measure_catalog/settings bootstrap). Reproducing this as a context shim would mean copying real business logic (Signal/Loss/Comparison/Trend, 150+ lines) rather than restoring a binding, so classification stays excluded rather than final.
